def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    objs=[]
    for col in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        for cl in clusters4(g,col):
            objs.append({'col':col,'cells':cl,'shape':norm(cl)})
    # corner: 1-thick object (no 2x2 solid) with max size
    def thick1(cl):
        s=set(cl)
        for i,j in cl:
            if (i+1,j) in s and (i,j+1) in s and (i+1,j+1) in s: return False
        return True
    corners=[o for o in objs if thick1(o['cells'])]
    corner=max(corners,key=lambda o:len(o['cells']))
    cnt=collections.Counter(o['shape'] for o in objs)
    dupshapes=[sh for sh,c in cnt.items() if c>1]
    best=max(dupshapes,key=len)
    grp=sorted([o for o in objs if o['shape']==best],key=lambda o:min(i for i,j in o['cells']))
    tgt=grp[-1]  # lower
    for i,j in tgt['cells']: g[i][j]=corner['col']
    return g
